instruction: A candid black and white photograph in a close-up shot. On an outdoor city embankment, the woman in the black cap and dark coat (R2) on the right embraces the man with curly hair (R1) on the left. The woman looks at the man with a gentle, affectionate smile, her arm wrapped around his shoulder. The man is positioned with his back partially to the camera, facing her. The soft, diffuse daylight from an overcast sky illuminates their faces, with a blurred background of the riverbank.
